question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Lick your wounds

options.text: To go away and recover from bad experience

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "To go away and recover from bad experience".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Lick your wounds"** means to retreat and take time to recover after an emotional or physical setback or bad experience. (अपने घावों को चाटना / अपने अनुभव से उबरना)

 
 
• **Example:** After losing the match, the team needed some time to lick their wounds and regroup.
 
 
 
• In this context, it refers to taking a break to heal and recover from a tough situation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: To curse a lot** (बहुत ज्यादा शाप देना): Refers to frequently using foul or offensive language.

 
 
• **Example:** He was so angry after the argument that he started to curse a lot.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To prepare for further confrontation** (आगे के टकराव के लिए तैयार होना): Means getting ready for another disagreement or fight.
 
 
• **Example:** After the heated debate, both sides decided to prepare for further confrontation.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To ask for help** (मदद मांगना): Refers to seeking assistance or support from someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He had no choice but to ask for help from his friends during his financial crisis.
